_doc: Camera overrides for render_job.py (three.js metres, Y-up). hero_auto: apartment hero stills (living/bedroom/bathroom) are re-framed by ray-casting the furnished room (clear foreground, long view, window in frame; door leaves of that room hidden). 'shots' entries override any field of a shot after that (position, lookAt, lens_mm, clip_start, auto:false to keep the exported/explicit camera, hide:[object-name substrings]). 'extra_exterior' / 'extra_common' add shots.

extra_exterior.name: Rear gardens and garden facade, golden hour
